non_claims: The configuration at C-2 (progoitrin versus epiprogoitrin) is not resolved.
The rest of the side chain (the aldehyde lost) is assigned by the precursor composition hypothesis.

notes: The 332 and 136 ions are reported for progoitrin, epiprogoitrin, glucosibarin and gluconapoleiferin in four ion-trap papers (three with standards) and one QqQ-LIT paper; no QTOF or Orbitrap data exist, so the rule is calibrated on other.

competitors.note: Alkenyl glucosinolates without the 2-hydroxy group (sinigrin, gluconapin) show neither ion (Fabre 2007 Table 1; Lee 2008 Table 2; Hooshmand 2021 Table 4).

priors.note: In negative-mode direct infusion of the standards only the deprotonated glucosinolate ions were seen, with no adduct or degradation ions.
The deprotonated sulfate [M-H]- is the predominant glucosinolate ion in negative ESI.
